activity_text: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Anti-MRSA, anti-sepsis, Hemolytic, Anticancer
comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is unique and shows only very low similarity (87.5%) to Brevinin-1SC Activity: S. aureus NCTC 6538 or MRSA 12,493 (MIC 2 uM), E. faecium NCTC 12,697 (MIC 4 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 4 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 43,816 (MIC 8 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC CRM 9027 (MIC 8 uM), A. baumannii BAA 747 (MIC 8 uM), and C.albicans ATCC 10,231 (MIC >128 uM). MBC same or slightly higher. Antimicrobial robustness: NaCl-sensitive: E. coli-dependent (150 mM), KCl-insensitive: E. coli (4.5 mM); CaCl2-sensitive: E. coli-dependent (2 mM); MgCl2-insensitive: E. coli-dependent (1 mM); ZnCl2-insensitive: E. coli (8 uM); NH4Cl-insensitive: E. coli (6 uM); FeCl3-insensitive: E. coli (4 uM). Structure: random coil in buffer NH4Ac and helical in 50% TFE or LPS. In vitro toxicity: horse RBC: HC50 37.64 uM, hemolytic. Less toxic to HaCaT skin cells (IC50 62.71 uM). Also showed effects on both H838 (IC50 6.88 uM) and MCF-7 (IC50 7.6 uM) cancer cell lines.
reference_text: Comput Struct Biotechnol J. 2024 Sep 19;23:3391-3406. doi: 10.1016/j.csbj.2024.09.006. PubMed

activity_text: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Antifungal, candidacidal, anti-sepsis, Anticancer
comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is unique and shows only very low similarity (91.67%) to brevinine-1pl K: 26%; V=F=A: 13%. Activity: S. aureus NCTC 6538 (MIC 32 uM), MRSA 12,493 (MIC >128 uM) (MRSA-inactive), E. faecium NCTC 12,697 (MIC 64 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739 (MIC 2 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 43,816 (MIC 4 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC CRM 9027 (MIC 16 uM), A. baumannii BAA 747 (MIC 16 uM), and C. albicans ATCC 10,231 (MIC 16 uM). MBC same or slightly higher. Structure: random coil in buffer NH4Ac and helical in 50% TFE. In vitro toxicity: horse RBC: HC50 >128 uM, less hemo.lytic. Less toxic to HaCaT skin cells (IC50 128.1 uM). Also showed effects on both H838 (IC50 4.54 uM) and MCF-7 (IC50 7.19 uM) cancer cell lines. Animal model:wax moth: the peptide treated up to 10 mg/kg showed 90% protective of Galleria mellonella from E. coli infection (cf. control 30-50% survival).
